description: This file defines the 'PurchaseList' result class for the Coocook schema, including database table mapping, relationships, and methods for managing purchase lists within a project.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::PurchaseList
classes.description: Represents a purchase list entity in the database schema, with methods for managing purchase list data and relationships.

methods.name: is_default
methods.description: Checks if this purchase list is the default for its project.

methods.name: make_default
methods.description: Sets this purchase list as the default for its project.

methods.name: move_items_ingredients
methods.description: Moves items and ingredients from this purchase list to another specified purchase list, handling conflicts and updates.
